system.longDesc:
Requirement: Digital Arcana (Master)

Cost: 10 PP

Time: 1 minute

Target Number: 15

Test: None

Your arcane access to the digital realm makes you a natural hacker. For the duration of the encounter, you can add your Intelligence (Digital Arcana) focus to any Intelligence tests to hack into a computer, and the bonus stacks with any other applicable ability focus. You perform stunts while hacking at –1 SP cost, and you can cast other digital arcana spells on digital devices connected to the network you are accessing, allowing you to bypass, tag, or crash them.
